query:
-- House races in General with same candidate in both slots (duplicates)
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status
FROM house_races
WHERE status = 'General' 
  AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL 
  AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL
  AND candidate1_name = candidate2_name
ORDER BY state_code, district;
